description: Mistral AI's API is provided by Mistral AI SAS, whose registered offices are in Paris, France.
residency_notes: Mistral's global endpoint does not promise a specific inference location, while the EU and US regional endpoints route model execution to data centers in the EU/EEA and US respectively. Mistral says data is hosted in the EU by default, with an explicit US endpoint available. Regional inference does not regionalize control-plane data, and Zero Data Retention is a separate retention control available on request for eligible plans.
prompt_training_notes: Mistral says API data is not used for model training by default, but its privacy controls documentation also says Labs model usage can be used to train Mistral models in accordance with the Commercial Terms of Service.

sources.notes: Mistral AI SAS's official legal notice lists its registered offices at 15 Rue des Halles, 75001 Paris, France.

verification.notes: Location metadata verified; other provider policy and catalogue fields were not re-audited.
